items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1961-06-21
items.q: Trombone was a big, uh, was a big, uh, instrument with them. There's Lassus trombone that, uh, slide, you know, smear.

ctx.x: Do you think any of those shows, uh, were also the shows that you might see up in, uh, Michigan?

Would they travel that far? They would travel all over, yes. Uh, in, in New Orleans, they would always stay a week because they, it was such a big jump from another town that they, they would have to. In Grand Rapids, it was usually one or two nights stand up in Michigan. They wanted to split weeks or something like that. Yeah, split weeks. But down New Orleans, they would always spend a week and they would always, uh, have good, hot music. Trombone was a big, uh, was a big, uh, instrument with them. There's…

they, they really put it on. And... It's surprising what big bands they had. They, they often had a, uh, marching band in the street that would have two or three drums and choirs of, uh, trumpets and trombones. Well... And, uh, then a pit band, which might be a different instrumentation. Strange.
